geometry_inputs: original ordered projected needle mesh vertices
ordered long tick pixels and angular spacing
immutable unrotated scaled template vertex coordinates
template_family_rule: Only the observed ordered vertex count selects one of the three templates; all correspondences retained.
pixel_rule: original integer annotation cell center +0.5; original integer casing bbox
needle_fit: per-vertex height lift; centered 2D orthogonal Procrustes; translation reported but not used for angle/readout
tick_fit: complex LS with free circle center and amplitude against exp(-i*j*spacing); no assumed tick height
readout: first tick phi0 - object rotation theta; a physical tip-anchor decoder must subtract intrinsic beta; fixed arc-midpoint unwrap; clip [0,1]
point_height_contract: Each vertex uses its own template height; no equality of origin/outside heights is assumed.
score_join: Targets and fixed baseline outputs are joined after geometry predictions are saved.

reference.checkpoint: ordinary supervised MobileNetV4, seed20262020, best epoch63

common_ordinary_rule: Both fixed references have error <=1%FS;1495 images. The r8-only ordinary population has1497 images.

gate.G0: All1506 valid, physically auditable input contract, raw error <=1%FS everywhere

limits: GT-assisted geometry diagnostic, not an RGB result or upper bound
Does not validate a sparse endpoint head
Repeatedly inspected source-development population, not a blind test
Original H used a float casing box while released box and point labels are integer; residual remains visible
Original annotations do not record generation commit; per-image correspondence consistency is numerical evidence, not recovered per-image provenance
